acceptance.given: The named Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifacts are enumerated from repository-owned manifests or schemas, and their authorization metadata is parsed as structured machine-readable data.

oracle.expected: Every specified artifact has parsed authorization_set=[]; the report identifies each artifact and records the empty set, with zero non-empty entries.
forbidden: Any specified artifact has one or more machine-verifiable authorization entries.
An artifact is omitted, unreadable, malformed, or evaluated only by prose while reported compliant.
oracle.observable: A deterministic validator report lists every specified artifact with authorization_set=[] and a zero non-empty count, and exits successfully.

acceptance.then: Run the repository Toolchain authorization validator against the complete artifact enumeration and inspect its per-artifact and aggregate results.
acceptance.when: During acceptance verification after artifact enumeration is fixed and before acceptance-passed publication authorization.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the authorization validator against a named artifact whose structured metadata contains one authorization entry; verification fails and identifies the non-empty set.
Run the validator with a named artifact omitted, unreadable, or malformed; verification fails closed instead of treating it as authorization_set=[].

affected_subjects: Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifacts
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require structured machine-verifiable authorization metadata for every named artifact to parse as an empty set; reject missing, malformed, non-empty, or omitted artifacts so they cannot support acceptance-passed publication.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing manifest fields and validator report/exit conventions; revert only the empty-authorization enforcement while retaining compatibility coverage.

slice_hint.state_transition: Authorization-set exposure is unestablished or non-empty -> deterministic per-artifact evidence records authorization_set=[] for all named artifacts -> artifact authorization condition is satisfied for the separate publication-owner gate.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator succeeds only when every enumerated Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifact is readable, structurally parsed, and has authorization_set=[]; any non-empty, missing, malformed, or omitted artifact fails.
